chunks: He said: Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qarshi reported to me by way of permission, who said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddhal narrated to us, who said: al-Husayn ibn Nasr narrated to us, who said: my father narrated to us, who said: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Abdul Malik narrated to us, who said: Abu Abdullah Abdul Rahman al-Masoodi narrated to us, from Amr ibn Hurayth al-Ansari, from al-Husayn ibn Salamah al-Bunani, from Abu Khalid al-Kabuli, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, who said:

When the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, had finished washing, shrouding, and embalming the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, he allowed the people in and said: "Let ten of you enter at a time to offer prayers upon him." So they entered, and the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, stood between him and them
and recited: "Indeed, God and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with a complete greeting."
And the people would repeat what he said. Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "And this was how the funeral prayer was offered upon him, may God bless him and his family."

key_terms.الصلاة عليه: The funeral prayer offered upon the Prophet
key_terms.تحنيط: Embalming or applying perfume/camphor (hunoot) to the deceased
key_terms.تغسيل: Ritual washing (ghusl) of the deceased body
key_terms.تكفين: Shrouding the deceased in burial cloth (kafan)

ai.seo_question: How was the funeral prayer of Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) performed according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) describes the unique funeral rites of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), personally conducted by Imam Ali (AS). Rather than a standard funeral prayer with set rak'ahs, Imam Ali had people enter in groups of ten and led them in reciting Quranic verse 33:56 as their prayer. This account preserves a distinctly Shia understanding of how the Prophet's funeral was conducted, emphasizing Ali's central role in the rites.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 5. He said: ‘Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qarshi reported to me, by way of permission (to transmit further) from Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddhal, who reported from al-Husayn ibn Nasr, who reported from his father, who reported from Ahmad ibn Abdulla ibn Abdul Malik, who reported from Abdul Rehman al-Masoodi, from Amru ibn Hurayth al-Ansari, from al-Husayn ibn Salemah al-Banani, from Abu Khalid al-Kabuli, from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali Al-Baqir, peace be upon him, who said:

When Amirul Mu’mineen finished giving Ghusl, Kafan and Hunoot to the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, he allowed people in, and said: "Enter in the grou of tens for offering your prayers upon him." They entered, and Amirul Mu’mineen stood between him (i.e. the Prophet) and them
and recited: ’Surely, Allah and His angels send blessings on the Prophet. O you who believe, you should also send blessings and peace upon him.’ (al-Ahzab, 33:56)"
People repeated what he said. Abu Ja’far said: "This was the prayer offered on him, peace be upon him and his progeny."
